retrievalProfile.description: A fragmented collage featuring a woman submerged in teal water wearing a diamond-encrusted corset, overlaid with orange glittery condensed typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex visual composition using a central portrait of a woman in a bathtub filled with teal-tinted water, wearing a silver jeweled lattice corset. The image is broken into rectangular fragments that overlap, creating a collage effect. Large, condensed sans-serif text with a heavy orange glitter texture is distributed across the frame, appearing both above and below the water surface.
coreVisualRelationships: Complementary contrast between teal water and orange glitter text
Repetition of diamond textures in the corset and jewelry
Fragmented rectangular overlays creating depth and distortion
Submerged subject interacting with surface reflections and light refraction
coreInvariants: Heavy orange glitter texture applied to all display typography
Teal-tinted water medium with visible surface ripples and refractions
Silver jeweled lattice or chainmail garment as the primary subject texture

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally located, viewed from a high angle, filling the majority of the frame from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes, positioned slightly above the center, serve as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the scattered text fragments in a clockwise spiral, starting from the top left, moving to the right, and ending at the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with water, jewelry, and collage fragments.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Teal and cyan tones in the water and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright orange glitter used for the typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Silver and white highlights from the diamonds and water reflections.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the orange text against a medium-value, cool-toned background.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are filled with a high-density orange and gold glitter texture
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with varying placement to create rhythm.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature of the display text.
Provides the necessary verticality and clean sans-serif structure.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-angle photo of a woman submerged in teal water wearing a silver jeweled corset, with rectangular collage fragments of the same scene overlapping the main image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply extra-condensed uppercase sans-serif text in a scattered layout, filled with a vibrant orange glitter texture and a subtle drop shadow.

verificationChecks: Is the text filled with a coarse orange glitter texture?
Are there visible rectangular collage fragments overlapping the subject?
Is the water a distinct teal or cyan hue?
Is the font extra-condensed and bold?

adjustableVariables: Glitter color (orange to gold or pink)
mustRedesign: Do not use standard flat colors for text; must be glitter-textured.
Do not use a single-layer background; must be fragmented/collaged.

mustAchieve: Realistic water refraction on the subject
Clear contrast between orange and teal

postGenerationChecks: Check that the glitter texture looks tactile and reflective.
Ensure the collage fragments have distinct edges.
Verify the teal water maintains a consistent tone across fragments.
Confirm the text is legible despite the heavy texture.
recipe.reuseFormula: Submerged Subject + Jeweled Texture + Fragmented Collage + Glitter Typography
